tasks.title: Essay: Event Sustainability Priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: Your class has listened to a radio discussion about how arts institutions can make their major events more environmentally sustainable. You have made the notes below.

paragraphs: Contractor standards are the single most effective lever because they force every supplier to meet a minimum environmental threshold.
Audience behaviour systems, such as deposit schemes for cups and programmes, can shift public habits at scale and generate positive PR.
Transparent resource auditing builds trust with funders and the public, but it is a reporting tool rather than a direct reduction measure.

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay for your tutor discussing two of the priorities in your notes. You should explain which priority you think is more credible for an arts institution to adopt, giving reasons in support of your answer. You may, if you wish, make use of the opinions expressed in the discussion, but you should use your own words as far as possible.

tasks.title: Proposal: Sustainable Events Framework
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: Your arts centre's executive board has decided to adopt an audited sustainable-events framework for all major public events. The board has invited proposals for how this framework should be implemented.

Write a proposal for the executive board. In your proposal, you should:

• recommend procurement criteria that contractors must meet
• suggest how operational ownership of sustainability targets should be assigned to staff
• outline how the centre will report resource use publicly

Write your proposal.

tasks.title: Email: Supplier Negotiation
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: You are the events manager at an arts centre that has just adopted a new resource policy requiring all suppliers to meet stricter environmental standards. One of your long-term suppliers, a catering company, has emailed you expressing concern about the cost and feasibility of the new requirements.

Write an email to the supplier. In your email, you should:

• explain the rationale behind the new resource policy
• acknowledge the practical constraints the supplier faces
• propose a transition timetable that allows the supplier to adapt

Write your email.

tasks.title: Review: Institutional Environmental Policy
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: You see this announcement on the website of a cultural-sector journal.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted: Institutional environmental policies
paragraphs: Our journal is publishing a series of reviews of environmental policies adopted by cultural institutions. Have you observed or experienced the implementation of such a policy at an arts centre, museum or theatre?

Write a review for our journal. Describe the policy and assess its credibility, evaluate its impact on the visitor experience, and consider whether the policy could be replicated in other cultural venues.
The most insightful reviews will be published in our next issue.
